summary: In the Badlands, Lotwil Veriatus is ready to summon a powerful elemental.

sections.title: A Groundbreaking Day
sections.body: Lotwil calls out that the shackles are finished. The time has come. He asks Lucien and Servo to witness the summoning with you. Alchemy, engineering and the arcane come together in the shackles, and Lotwil expects a powerful elemental to answer on this groundbreaking day.

sections.title: After the Summoning
sections.body: The summoning ends differently than Lotwil expected. After you defeat the Fam'retor Guardian, Lotwil asks you to bring back the Shackles of Elemental Binding. He cannot say what went wrong. Still, he is glad the magics were ready to send the creature back to its own plane.

faq.answer: Lotwil Veriatus made the Shackles of Elemental Binding by joining alchemy, engineering and the arcane. Lucien and Servo are with him in the Badlands.

faq.q: What are the Shackles of Elemental Binding?
faq.answer: The Shackles of Elemental Binding combine alchemy, engineering and the arcane. Lotwil has just finished them for the powerful elemental he means to summon.

faq.q: Who does Lotwil call to bear witness?
faq.answer: Lotwil calls on Lucien and Servo to witness the summoning with you.
Before this, you brought cog #5 to Lotwil.
